reasons: Evidence is from interactive mode; re-run in pipeline mode before approval

coverage.text: POST /api/intakes with a client name, a project type (ECOMMERCE, WEBSITE or API) and a description of at least 20 characters returns 201 with a reference like INT-1001 and status RECEIVED
coverage.clarified_as: Reference format: 'INT-' then digits (INT-1001 is the first). All three project types accepted.

coverage.text: A description shorter than 20 characters returns 400 with the error "Describe what you want in at least 20 characters"
coverage.clarified_as: Under 20 = 19 or fewer characters after trimming; exactly 20 is accepted.

coverage.text: GET /api/intakes/{reference} returns the submitted intake, and an unknown reference returns 404
On the intake page, submitting a valid form shows "Your reference is INT-" followed by the number
On the intake page, a description shorter than 20 characters shows the error message and keeps what the client typed
coverage.clarified_as: 'Keeps what the client typed' = name, type and description fields still hold the entered values after the error.
